Team —

Thanks for getting through the interviews last week. Samir is our top finalist for the Senior Inference Engineer role; I pulled the raw scorecards into the attached sheet (samir_scorecards.xlsx) and a short summary (eval_summary_20241211.pdf). We still have variance between System Design and Coding panel scores.

Could each of you do two things by EOD today:
1) Put a single-line tiebreak rationale in column "Tiebreak" in the spreadsheet (one sentence: hire / no-hire + reason).
2) Reply in-thread with your preferred calibration anchor (example: weight more on system design for infra-heavy roles).

If we have mixed votes, I want to run a 20-minute sync at 3:30pm PT to close. If everyone leans hire, I'll draft the offer plan and loop Legal/Comp.

Attachments: samir_scorecards.xlsx, eval_summary_20241211.pdf

I put my note in the spreadsheet. System design mattered more for our infra roadmap, so my calibration anchor is: System Design 60 / Coding 30 / Collaboration 10.
